Name: Stardew Hydraulics
Author: Alcalina
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Hydraulics adds an underground-style irrigation network to Stardew Valley, letting you place pipes and connect water pumps to automatically water farmland based on available flow and power.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of SMAPI 4.5.2+.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Content Patcher.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip Hydraulics.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the Hydraulics folder inside your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Build and remove irrigation pipes on the main farm (also works on Beach Farm).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place tiered water pumps (Bronze, Steel, Gold, Iridium).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Automatic watering based on network flow.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional energy requirement for pumps.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Configurable build costs, refunds, and per-tile water cost.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pipe edit mode with in-world overlays.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Multiplayer sync support (not fully tested yet — please report issues).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]GMCM integration for in-game configuration.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Hydraulics creates an underground irrigation network using [b]pipes + pumps[/b].
Once set up, crops on connected pipe tiles are watered automatically.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]1) Controls (default keys)[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Toggle Pipe Edit Mode: [b]End[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Reload config in-game: [b]F5[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]2) Pipe Edit Mode[/b]
When Pipe Edit Mode is ON:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Left click: place pipe on a valid tile.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Right click: remove existing pipe (refund applies).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Placement/removal is blocked if the player cannot act (menu open, dialogue, etc.).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pipe placement is only allowed on valid farm tiles.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pipes cannot be placed on tiles occupied by pumps.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]3) Pump Interactions[/b]
When Pipe Edit Mode is OFF:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Right click a pump[/b] to trigger a local irrigation refresh.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Using a hoe on a pipe tile can also trigger irrigation sync.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]4) How Watering Works[/b]
The network is recalculated and applied:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]At day start.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]After relevant edits/changes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]After pump/object updates.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]If it is raining, daily irrigation is skipped.
A tile is watered only if:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]It has a pipe with water flow.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]And it contains tilled soil/crops.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]5) Power / Energy Behavior[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If [b]RequireEnergyForPumps = true[/b], pumps need valid power conditions to produce flow.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If disabled, pumps can provide flow without energy requirements.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]6) Visual Overlays and Indicators[/b]
In Pipe Edit Mode:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pipe network overlay is shown.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Placement helper (valid/blocked tile color).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Subnetwork flow text (current/max flow).[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Pump status marker colors:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Red: unpowered or no water near.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Yellow: powered but idle (no pipes connected or raining day).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Green: actively producing flow.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]7) Config Options[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Enabled mod` (default: `true`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Reload config key (default: `F5`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Toggle pipe edit mode key (default: `End`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Require energy for pumps (default: `true`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Pipe build gold cost (default: `100`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Pipe build copper ore cost (default: `2`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Pipe destroy gold refund (default: `50`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Pipe destroy copper ore refund (default: `1`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Water cost per tile (default: `0.25`)[/color][/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][color=#d4d4d8]Play sprinkler animation (default: `true`)[/color][/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Quick Start[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Press [b]End[/b] to enable Pipe Edit Mode.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place pipes with left click.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Craft a pump (unlocked at Farming levels 2/4/6/8)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place a pump connected to that network.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If energy mode is enabled, ensure power is available.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Sleep: irrigation applies automatically on non-rainy days.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI (minimum API version 4.5.2).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pathoschild.ContentPatcher (required dependency).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu for easier settings management.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout Outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Special thanks to the creators of these now-obsolete mods, which were a major source of inspiration for Hydraulics:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10198]Simple Irrigation System[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10205]Pipe Irrigation[/url][/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Source code of my mods and maintained custom versions is available on [url=https://github.com/alca259/Mods-Game-StardewValley/tree/main/Hydraulics]my GitHub[/url].[/color]
